title: Temporary Admin Elevation SOP and Support Snippets for RBAC v2
creator: Aisha Gupta
description: Create an operational SOP and a set of support macros/snippets for safely granting temporary admin elevation under RBAC v2. This ticket covers: 1) the just-in-time elevation flow tied to SSO/SAML approval and IdP evidence, 2) audit-log enrichment to surface who approved and why, 3) TTL and automated revocation enforcement, 4) support macros for oncall to issue, verify, and revoke elevations, and 5) runbook guidance for responding to suspected misuse. Goal is to reduce time-to-elevate for critical incidents while preserving auditability and least-privilege guarantees.
acceptance_criteria: SOP doc published in Confluence with step-by-step JIT elevation flow and decision checks
Three support macros added to PagerDuty/Slack macros library: request-elevation, approve-elevation, revoke-elevation
Audit events emitted for grant/renew/revoke that include approver SSO assertion id, justification text, and TTL
Automated TTL enforcement tested in staging: elevations expire and privileges are revoked without manual action
Security review signoff recorded and runbook linked from oncall playbook
tasks: Draft SOP: flow diagram, actors (requester, approver, oncall, system), and decision matrix
Add audit event fields: approver_idp_subject, approval_ticket_id, justification, ttl_seconds
Implement short-lived elevation token with server-side enforcement and revoke endpoint
Create Slack/PagerDuty macros (text templates + idempotency keys) and add to support macros repo
End-to-end test: simulate incident in staging with SSO IdP assert, approval via Slack macro, and automated revocation
Security review and tabletop with oncall and SRE; incorporate feedback into SOP
Publish SOP and link to Console admin docs and training slides
